title: AgentScope
description: For an assistant acting for a person (an Entra caller): the agent whose scope applied to this read, and what was left out (D60). Only the template's packs and the mandatory packs are in scope; without a delegation, only the mandatory packs.

agent.description: issued: the agent instance acting for the person.

reason.description: refused or unavailable: why there is no delegation.

packsOutsideAgentScope.description: Requested packs the agent may not read; whether they exist is not said.
